requirements.description: The user requires energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. The other requested criteria (gross floor area, capacity for 60 people, proximity to public transport, location in Turin, CDP/PNRR funding) are not energy efficiency requirements and were not translated into filters.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. The energy class and public transport requirements are outside the reference columns and are handled elsewhere. The conversion to student residence is a future use, so it does not affect the current typology.
The user explicitly requires proximity to public transport. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) because the user expresses nearness.
The building is to be converted into a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary for the project. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area of at least 850 sqm, energy class A1 to C, mobility score of at least 71 and education score of at least 75, all within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
